default.name: Current Project
default.description: Robot manipulation project with strong interest in world models, diffusion policy, video pretraining, and transferable embodied methods.

world-action-model.title: Action-Conditional Video Prediction using Deep Networks in Atari Games
world-action-model.summary: Early action-conditioned predictive modeling work that learns future frames from observations and control inputs, making action representation an explicit part of the learned dynamics.
world-action-model.reason: A foundational paper for treating environment dynamics as an action-conditioned predictive model.

world-action-model.title: Deep Visual Foresight for Planning Robot Motion
world-action-model.summary: Classical robotics paper that uses predictive visual dynamics models for planning, connecting video prediction to action selection in manipulation.
world-action-model.reason: A key robotics precursor to modern world-model-based action planning.

world-action-model.title: World Models
world-action-model.summary: Canonical paper showing how compact latent world models can support policy learning in imagined rollouts.
world-action-model.reason: The canonical modern starting point for latent world models in sequential decision making.

world-action-model.title: Learning Latent Dynamics for Planning from Pixels
world-action-model.summary: PlaNet learns latent dynamics directly from pixels and performs planning inside the latent space, establishing a practical model-based RL template.
world-action-model.reason: The paper that turned latent world models into a practical planning recipe.

world-action-model.title: Dream to Control: Learning Behaviors by Latent Imagination
world-action-model.summary: Dreamer replaces online planning with policy optimization inside imagined latent trajectories, making world models a scalable behavior-learning backbone.
world-action-model.reason: A milestone that unified world modeling and action learning through latent imagination.

world-action-model.title: Mastering Atari with Discrete World Models
world-action-model.summary: DreamerV2 demonstrates that discrete latent world models can support high-performance action learning on challenging visual control benchmarks.
world-action-model.reason: A strong bridge from classic latent world models to high-capacity action models.

robot-learning.title: A Survey of Robot Learning from Demonstration
robot-learning.summary: Survey on learning from demonstration and core robotics imitation learning foundations.
robot-learning.reason: Good classic entry point for robot learning and imitation-style pipelines.

robot-learning.title: Diffusion Policy: Visuomotor Policy Learning via Action Diffusion
robot-learning.summary: Representative modern policy-learning paper with strong downstream relevance to robot manipulation.
robot-learning.reason: A strong anchor paper for current manipulation policy work.
